details:
So i have a pretty long list for this suggestion that could be extremely benificial both server side and client side and could bring increased revenue to the game.

So lets start off with the biggest issue which i understand why the coders did this, but with the influx of players now this issue should be looked at and considered heavily. This would be just how the game is coded in general being it is all client side mostly with some blaring flaws that could if even a medium knowledge coder knows how to do this is the fact that the sdk is one in plain reading site as in you can use even simple things to open it and that it self exposes a ton of flaws is the fact that front facing stuff that shouldn't be view-able in the least is, one being addresses(to which im not going to say for reasons) Those should *NOT* be client side really none of them should be in no reason shape or form in no game or website for that matter for example should be front side being if a address's is shown could be exploited by tracing or backtracking it. So this is where my suggestion for this will begin 
1. Make it so the critical stuff you dont want people to crack put it server side, make alot of it server side being inless u can get into the server that stufff cannot be cracked or modified like we have and had a issues of before. 
2. Make the sdk more locked down if it has to be client side make less important stuff client side and also make it so u have to do extra work to get into it and make the code harder to figure out being now its relitively easy to figure out what things do what.
3. I cant say this enough put protection on front ended addresses,  even the site make it so its cloudflair protected so no ddos attacks can bring the site down, and also put a proxy on it so it wont show the true address if someone makes it to that point to knock them off and out detection systems in place so u know whats happening with the site backend and know if a intruder is trying to get in or a large data flood is coming in u can shut that port down on the site firewall/cloudflair.
4. Now on to the servers on this last protection, please put ddos protection on the servers that is rated for more, right now its low being the servers have issues even with a mass user login, which is a sign off the data is overloading the server so put a date influx rate limiter on it so it can help that and can limit the load on the server or get a better server backbone that is rated for high data influx. Plus with the trolls in vrchat im sure there some of them that yes have the ways to take servers down and cripple them and even null route them and if a high ddos protection is there it can stop that in the tracks along with blocking ports where large packets is coming into before the attacks can be successful.

Now tot he second issues i see is optimazion issue that is in large can be fixed if my first set of considerations can be taken into light.
1. This has been suggested by many others by now and would in turn ill suggest a new thing ive heard only one person mention. 
*The poly count is only but a very small issue of the larger issue with what causes lag in game IE. Draw calls, dynamic bones, separate meshes, unoptimized rig's all of those is the bigger issue but also the sound api and the sound ui is what ive been suggested is a big hog being the sound API and ui is very very unoptimized for the amount of people in the room, being im sure a large majority of it is due to it relaying on client connection instead of routing it through the servers and letting servers handle the audio part of it that it should be in the first place to save the resources for the users instead of making their setups have to worry about not only game visuals but audio also. 
How could this issue be fixed? well if my coding part is taken into consideration then one could do this but if the sdk is allowed in plain sight a person can overide the client code and that only create this issue again if this issue is fixed. So This really comeback to to much is client side and in plain text and not enough is optimized that a server could be stable with this inless u throw a ton of servers on a unoptimized system to make up for how much extra resouces is needed.

Another suggestion is somehow linkin steam friends with vrchat account being it does suck when u first play and make friends on a steam account then u move and u lose them so why not link vr accounts with steam in the first place, and use their api system for it? that would make alot of players happy and would also make it more friendly for people who wants to make vr characters in the future but not wanting to do it soonish but still wanting a vrchat account but also wanting to get their steam friends on the game.

Now for the revenue thing, As we all know the game it self with how it setup is in a gray area of how they can gain revenue, so i have a couple suggestions since the game has grown so much more companies would be willing to help us out i bet
1. Talk to amazon, see if u can become official partners with them, perhaps if u are partners you can one get increased revenue from them for promoting them somehow also could get servers at a cheaper but could get better quility servers that can handle far more.
2. Talk to major headset manufactures IE. Occulus, Vive, and ect who makes both vr and ar things, those companies im sure would love to be on board with us if we can make it worth their wild and also would maybe help fund us some for much needed improvements
3. Talk to even higher end servers hosters that offeres major ddos protection and redundent systems if a address is flooded,  Being that would help on downtime and also would be protecting us from that, and perhaps would be able to have a better higher data flow backend that can handle more recursive logins. 
4. Talk to cloudFlair, The site as it stands isnt much to protect with from the front end i see(No cloudflair or ddos protection in place that i can see) So if u can protect that it in turn would protect the logins being id bet that stuff is linked in sql database somehow, and would help login issues be resolved better and quicker.

All of this would help the community and servers and be much more streamlined and optimized in many ways, And would bring in increased revenue being in order to fix some of this the coder would have to be ***Completly*** redone to be server side only and no access out side of it and that takes time and would require a larger team with more widespan skillsets on server side code would be needed and coding in a large game is not easy and would need to be payed for so that can help bring that to the table and would be very easily optimized and pushed far easier in the future instead of relaying on sdk and people breaking it and cracking it and then hacked clients and ddos attacks can be decreased or stopped as a whole and would make more time for less busy team and allow much needed ease for the community on risks and such

If anything i said is confusing and or doesnt make sende(Which im sure it does being im not the greatest typing explainer) I will be activly looking on here and can be asked to talk in vrchat to higher ups if any ideas is relievent and or needs clearing up im always up for a convo, 

Thanks for reading this to all and hope some argrees and some of these ideas can be taken into consideration.
title: This is my suggestions on what would help vr chat as a whole, and would most likely be a large project but i feel would stop the servers downtime and also hacked clients issues
